summary: A flash drive as a disk, from its table to its removal, each case a boot of its own that tests/cases/machine/usbdisk_scenario.c drives

cases.behavior: an MBR stick is named and sized as a block device, and both its volumes mount; the table reads back through /dev/disk0

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the sticks' copies, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell
run usbdiskprobe report
run usbdiskprobe volumes

assertions.checks: usbdiskprobe report finds /dev/disk0 a block device that /proc/usb names with a size and a count of free names, prints USBDISKPROBE OK and exits 0

usbdiskprobe volumes mounts, reads and unmounts the FAT32 volume of /dev/disk0p1 and the exFAT one of /dev/disk0p2, reads the MBR they came from in sector 0 of /dev/disk0, prints USBDISKPROBE OK and exits 0
no line USBDISKPROBE FAIL appears on the console up to the end of the last probe's run

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case needs sticks of its own layout, built on the host and attached to QEMU's xHCI controller as USB mass storage, which the Lenovo has none of
